title: Cycle Navigator Skill Decomposition vs Mechanical Baseline
question: What part of Cycle Navigator is genuine incremental skill versus a mechanical volatility/range baseline?
hypothesis: Cycle Navigator's strongest incremental value may lie in regime/rotation/transmission interpretation rather than raw weekly high-low range prediction.
baseline: Frozen CN forecasts and scores compared against preregistered mechanical baselines with identical information-time constraints.
required_analysis: Separate range width, center/placement, containment, direction, regime, rotation and transmission skill.
Compare CN against dumb volatility-band and other simple frozen baselines.
Preserve score methodology changes and avoid retrospective normalization that alters frozen truth.
Test whether public/product usefulness survives even if range edge is weak.
Identify any score family where complexity adds no incremental value.
falsifier: CN does not outperform simple frozen baselines on decision-relevant components after width/complexity penalties, or any apparent advantage is explained by methodology drift.
kill_condition: Kill or demote any CN component whose incremental value over a simple baseline is not reproducible; do not rewrite historical public scores.
